doc: Every abstracted-cell pin on a net with no other pin (top-level ports excluded), from `klt extract` of the committed routed stream. Records where the extraction opens are; no cause claim, no fix claim. The LVS verdict of this group stays whatever its committed lvs.report.json records.

liberty.direction_note: signal pins carry the liberty's `direction`; pg pins carry their pg_type (primary_power->power, primary_ground->ground); null means the liberty was unavailable

corroboration.marker_scope: agrees exactly with the unused tie-cell output subset (tiel/ZN, tieh/Z) of summary.single_pin_nets, not with the total; single-pin nets outside that subset are not corroborated by it
corroboration.note: pnr.report.json def_net_names.single_pin_markers; a cheap corroboration only, not a substitute signal: wavetable_core matches with 480 of them

notes: klt extract --help (klayout-tools 0.8.0): anonymous net numbering ('$N' labels assigned to a net with no drawn label) is NOT a stable contract across klayout versions or host platforms (issue #1063) -- do not diff raw netlist text across environments. Net names in this record are observed values, explicitly non-contractual; no test asserts them.
The extracted SPICE and the LVS report escape these names as \$21170 etc.; this record carries the unescaped form ($21170).
